pages.text: The Crafter is a pivotal block in your Refined Storage network, responsible for executing crafting tasks using stored patterns. It supports speed upgrades to enhance crafting efficiency and can be chained to expand its capacity. This makes it an essential component for automating complex crafting operations.$(br2)Chaining$(br)A Crafter can be chained by letting them face each other. This is useful when connecting a Crafter to a single machine.

When you run out of slots in your first Crafter, the one facing the machine, you can put another Crafter behind the first Crafter to get additional Pattern slots.$(br2)Read $(l:autocrafting)this$() and $(l:autoprocessing)this$() for more.
